description: This Java class provides utility methods for dealing with generic entities, specifically retrieving the class type of an entity that extends SalesManagerEntity by inspecting class hierarchy and type parameters.

classes.name: GenericEntityUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to work with generic entity classes, especially to retrieve the class object of an entity extending SalesManagerEntity from class hierarchy and type arguments.

methods.name: getGenericEntityClassFromComponentDefinition
methods.description: Returns the Class object of an entity extending SalesManagerEntity by traversing the class's superclass hierarchy and examining generic type parameters. Throws IllegalArgumentException if no such type is found within a reasonable number of retries.
